content.description: Illustration showing crankshaft thrust clearance measurement with dial gauge and screwdriver prying the crankshaft

content.text: Install a dial gauge and measure the crankshaft thrust clearance while prying the crankshaft back and forth with a screwdriver.

content.description: Top view diagram of engine showing numbered sequence for removing bearing caps (numbered 1-14)

content.text: 20. REMOVE MAIN BEARING CAPS AND MEASURE OIL CLEARANCE

items.label: (a)
items.text: Gradually loosen and remove the bearing cap bolts in three passes and in the numerical order shown.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of bearing cap using prying motion with thrust washers

items.label: (b)
items.text: Using the removed bearing cap bolts, pry the bearing cap fore and aft, and remove it with the lower bearing and thrust washers (No. 4 journal only).

content.text:
• Keep the lower bearing inserted with the cap.
• Arrange the caps and lower thrust washers in correct order.
• Keep the upper bearings and upper thrust washers (for the No. 4 journal only) inserted in the cylinder block.

items.label: (e)
items.text: Check the journals and bearings for pitting and scratches.

content.text: If the journal or bearing is damaged, grind or replace the crankshaft and replace the bearing.

content.description: Illustration of two bearing shells showing their curved shape
Illustration showing installation of plastigage strip across main journals on cylinder block and crankshaft

items.label: (f)
items.text: Install the upper main bearing on the cylinder block and crankshaft.

items.label: (g)
items.text: Lay a strip of plastigage across the main journals.
